hero.subtext: We turn complex regulatory requirements into scalable software infrastructure for regulated industries.

problem.headline: Compliance shouldn't live in spreadsheets.
problem.subtext: Regulations are complex. Requirements change. Evidence is scattered across systems. Teams spend valuable time manually tracking controls, documents, risks and obligations.

manual.title: Manual processes
manual.description: Controls, policies and reviews tracked by hand, one spreadsheet update at a time.

fragmented.title: Fragmented evidence
fragmented.description: Proof of compliance scattered across tools, tickets, inboxes and shared drives.

changing.title: Changing regulations
changing.description: Requirements shift while the process built to satisfy them stays static.

disconnected.title: Disconnected systems
disconnected.description: Compliance sits apart from the systems where the actual work happens.

solution.headline: Compliance paperwork, handled by the platform.
solution.description: We turn policies, evidence and filings into a single automated workflow so your team spends less time chasing documents and more time running the business.
solution.disclaimer: Product mockup shown with illustrative data for demonstration purposes only.

intake.title: Automated intake
intake.description: Policies, contracts and certificates are captured and organized the moment they land.

verification.title: Continuous verification
verification.description: Every document is checked against the frameworks it needs to satisfy, automatically.

filing.title: Audit-ready filing
filing.description: Approved paperwork is filed and versioned, ready to hand to any auditor on demand.

architecture.headline: Built once. Adapted across industries.
architecture.subtext: The same compliance infrastructure adapts to different regulatory environments, extending into industry-specific modules and, over time, industry-specific products.
architecture.disclaimer: Industry modules are designed to support these sectors as the platform expands — not a reflection of current customers.

dashboard.headline: Your compliance command center.
dashboard.subtext: Controls, evidence, risk and monitoring, unified in a single operational view.
dashboard.footnote: Product mockup shown with illustrative data for demonstration purposes only.

integrations.headline: Connect the tools your teams already run on.
integrations.cardTitle: Sync controls, evidence and records automatically.
integrations.cardSubtext: No rip-and-replace. Statum plugs into the CRM, ERP and HR systems you already use.

industries.headline: Compliance infrastructure for regulated industries.
industries.subtext: The same core infrastructure is designed to support a range of regulatory environments as the platform expands.

logistics.name: Logistics
logistics.note: Built to support supply chains, transport operations and fleet management.

construction.name: Construction
construction.note: Designed for project delivery, contractors, site operations and compliance.

retail.name: Retail
retail.note: Built to support stores, ecommerce, inventory and customer operations.

hospitality.name: Hospitality
hospitality.note: Designed for hotels, restaurants, venues and guest-focused operations.

tourism.name: Tourism
tourism.note: Built to support travel businesses, tour operators and visitor experiences.

other.name: Other Industries
other.note: Flexible infrastructure designed to adapt to new sectors and business models.

howItWorks.headline: From regulation to operational infrastructure.
howItWorks.subtext: Compliance isn't a one time setup. Each cycle understand, build, monitor, scale feeds the next, so the infrastructure keeps pace as requirements and operations change.

understand.title: Understand
understand.description: Translate regulatory requirements into structured controls.

build.title: Build
build.description: Turn controls into policies, workflows and operational processes.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.description: Continuously track compliance and collect evidence.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Extend the same infrastructure across new requirements, entities and industries.

proof.headline: Built once. Built to hold up.
proof.subtext: We didn't bolt compliance onto old software. The infrastructure — controls, evidence, risk and monitoring — was built first, so every industry module inherits the same rigor.

modules.caption: core modules — controls, evidence, risk and monitoring

frameworks.caption: regulatory frameworks referenced, from ISO 27001 to the EU AI Act

industries.caption: industries the platform is designed to support

about.headline: Building the infrastructure behind the next generation of regulated businesses.
about.subtext: We're building a new approach to compliance: software infrastructure that can adapt to different regulatory environments, industries and business models. Based in Andorra, at the heart of Europe.

contact.headline: Ready to build compliance into your business?
contact.subtext: Talk to us about the compliance infrastructure your business needs.

shiftcomply.metaTitle: ShiftComply: seasonal staff, contracts and housing
shiftcomply.metaDescription: ShiftComply keeps seasonal contracts, staff rooms and work documents in one place for hotels, and warns you before anything expires.
shiftcomply.headline: Seasonal staff, contracts and housing, in one place.
shiftcomply.subtext: ShiftComply keeps every seasonal contract, staff room and work document together, and warns you before anything expires, so nobody stays in a room after their contract has ended.
shiftcomply.builtFor: Built for seasonal hotels in Andorra
shiftcomply.problemTitle: The end of the season is where things slip

rooms.title: Rooms outlive contracts
rooms.text: A contract ends, but the employee is still in a staff room, with no extension on file.

documents.title: Documents expire quietly
documents.text: Work permits, IDs and certificates run out without anyone noticing until an inspection.

spreadsheets.title: Everything is scattered
spreadsheets.text: Contracts in one folder, rooms in a spreadsheet, permits in someone's inbox.

shiftcomply.featuresSubtext: One view of who works for you, where they live and what is missing.

contracts.title: Contracts with warnings
contracts.text: See which contracts end in the next 30 days, renew them in one step and keep the history.

housing.title: Housing linked to contracts
housing.text: Every room stay follows the contract behind it, and overdue checkouts are flagged.

documents.title: Documents on file
documents.text: Signed contracts, IDs, permits and certificates per employee, with expiry dates and earlier versions.

reminders.title: Reminders and calendar
reminders.text: A calendar and timeline of contract ends, checkouts and expiring documents.

team.title: Your team, your gestoria
team.text: Invite managers, and give your gestoria read-only access instead of emailing spreadsheets.

import.title: Set up in minutes
import.text: Import staff from a spreadsheet and add a whole staff building at once.

one.title: Add your rooms and staff
one.text: Import your staff list and describe your staff buildings.

two.title: ShiftComply watches the dates
two.text: Contract ends, checkouts and document expiry dates are tracked for you.

three.title: Act on what needs attention
three.text: The dashboard shows what to renew, who to check out and what to collect.

privacy.access: Only people you invite can see your hotel, with administrator, manager or read-only access.
privacy.files: Documents are stored privately, open through short-lived links, and every view is recorded.
privacy.control: Archive people who leave, export your data, or delete records permanently.
